actionResult.summary: 关闭 D1-RA-001：以旧 Archify review 的完整生命周期信息结构为 authoring input，但保持正式 native workflow/lifecycle contract；扩展 Change reference 主图显式呈现 review/revise/re-review、non-author blocker STOP、archive/completed/Checkpoint 边界；扩展 Delivery reference 显式呈现 Full Test failed → Delivery Finding → Owner decision → corrective Change → Checkpoint → fresh Ready/authorization 回路，以及 passed → Actual/Compare → architecture acceptance → Owner finalize → Delivery Final/Merge/next Current；新增结构级 regression，保持 Current/Planned、thin CLI、Verification mapping、HTML derived/non-authoritative 与 E1 Actual/promotion 边界不变。
